title: Virtual lab setup skipped by user direction
observed_result: No virtual machine created or started; experiment skipped per explicit user instruction
remediation: If virtual lab evaluation is desired, deploy VirtualBox and Kali in an isolated environment with sufficient storage

title: SET unavailable and external mail omitted; benign local QR generated
observed_result: setoolkit command not found; Python qrcode generated benign QR targeting 127.0.0.1:18082; external mail and credential workflows blocked per safety policy
remediation: Install Social Engineer Toolkit in a dedicated Kali VM for full menu workflow simulation; keep phishing tests within isolated network bounds

title: CrypTool 2 unavailable; supplemental cryptographic demonstration provided
observed_result: CrypTool 2 Windows/.NET suite unavailable on Linux; local Python and OpenSSL scripts demonstrated Caesar, Playfair, MD5, and SHA-256 on synthetic inputs
remediation: Execute CrypTool 2 and Enigma Analyzer on Windows 10/11 or via complete Wine/.NET runtime if GUI analysis is required

title: Official Experiment 4 source manual not supplied
observed_result: Official source manual absent from supplied inventory; unrelated student file CSL4.pdf discarded to preserve privacy; no procedure invented
remediation: Supply official university lab manual for Experiment 4 to authorize and guide execution

title: Local DVWA inactive and loopback port 80 closed
observed_result: Apache httpd and MariaDB inactive; curl to http://127.0.0.1/DVWA failed (exit 7); Nmap verified port 80 closed; Nikto and Metasploit absent
remediation: Deploy and configure DVWA in a sandboxed container or local stack, then execute authorized Nmap and Nikto vulnerability scans

title: Hashcat missing and John 1.9.0 lacking raw-md5 format
observed_result: Intentionally weak password hashed to 5f4dcc3b5aa765d61d8327deb882cf99; Hashcat not found (exit 127); John failed on raw-md5 format (exit 1)
remediation: Install Hashcat with appropriate OpenCL/CUDA drivers or install John jumbo build supporting raw-md5 format

title: DVWA precondition failed; SQL injection tests blocked
observed_result: Curl probes to 127.0.0.1/dvwa failed (exit 7); no SQLi or blind SQLi payloads sent to protect system state and enforce scope
remediation: Start local authorized DVWA web application with MariaDB backend before running Boolean and blind SQLi test queries

title: DVWA precondition failed; XSS tests blocked
observed_result: Curl probes to 127.0.0.1/dvwa failed (exit 7); reflected and stored XSS test payloads not transmitted
remediation: Initialize local DVWA instance with low security level to safely test and document reflected and stored XSS sanitization

title: OWASP ZAP executable and web target absent
observed_result: zaproxy not installed; local candidate URL 127.0.0.1/dvwa unreachable; automated vulnerability scanning blocked
remediation: Install OWASP ZAP and start authorized local lab target (e.g. OWASP Juice Shop or DVWA container)

title: Direct tcpdump permission denied; reviewed dumpcap/TShark capture retained
observed_result: Direct tcpdump lacked CAP_NET_RAW; wireshark dumpcap captured loopback traffic; filtered to 20 frames (TCP, UDP, DNS, ICMP) without leaks
remediation: Grant packet capture capabilities (cap_net_raw, cap_net_admin) to capture group or run within a disposable VM

title: Firewall/IDS modification blocked to preserve host integrity
observed_result: Active host lacked disposable VM sandbox; UFW and Snort absent; unprivileged sudo; no firewall or IDS state modified
remediation: Provision an isolated Linux VM to safely configure UFW/iptables rules and Snort detection without risking primary host networking

title: DoS mitigation observation blocked due to missing service and tools
observed_result: Apache httpd inactive on port 80; hping3, UFW, and Snort absent; bounded 10-SYN loopback observation not executed
remediation: Install hping3 and activate Apache in a dedicated test VM with firewall and monitoring active

title: Local assessment verified port 80 closed; compliance tools absent on Fedora
observed_result: Nmap confirmed loopback port 80 closed; Apache service inactive; Debian-specific APT and UFW unavailable on Fedora 43
remediation: Run compliance audits against active services using platform-appropriate tools (e.g. dnf check-update, firewalld) or on Kali/Debian
